The LCM of the first 25 positive integers is

\[
\operatorname{lcm}(1,2,\dots,25)=2^4\cdot 3^2\cdot 5^2\cdot 7\cdot 11\cdot 13\cdot 17\cdot 19\cdot 23
=26,771,144,400.
\]

Matching with \(26A7114B4C0\):

\[
A=7,\quad B=4,\quad C=0.
\]

Thus,

\[
100A+10B+C=100(7)+10(4)+0=740.
\]

The answer is 740.
